card.name: Summon Familiar

operational.targets: One unoccupied space you can perceive within range.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute. If applied in initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; preserve that virtual phase through initiative changes, departure or death. Outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application and preserves that absolute deadline on entering initiative. An already-passed start never counts. Ends earlier if concentration ends or the familiar reaches 0 HP.
operational.resolution: No initial roll. At creation choose acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder and either a melee attack of reach 5 feet or a ranged attack of range 30 feet; both choices remain fixed. Its commanded attack uses your actual casting-class spell attack bonus.
operational.effect: Summon a Small elemental: AC 12+floor(PB/2), HP 2 times your casting class level, walking Speed 30 feet, saves equal to your PB, other checks +0, ordinary sight/hearing only. It understands your spoken commands without a speaking language or telepathy. Its one attack deals S d6 of the chosen elemental type on a hit, with no added ability damage modifier. S is 1/2/3/4 at casting-class levels 1/5/11/17. It acts immediately after you. Within 60 feet and able to perceive your command, your Bonus Action can command movement plus its one attack or another basic legal action. Without command it may defensively move and Dodge.
operational.scaling: Only the expressly printed companion profile scales: AC with PB, HP with this casting class level and damage S d6 at class levels 1/5/11/17. No generic upcast or other scaling.
operational.limitations: It shares the owner-wide one Bonus Action companion command and one damaging companion action per numbered round across all companions. Only one Summon Familiar from this spell per caster; it disappears at 0 HP or concentration end. Find Familiar remains a separate spell identity, repertoire selection and source, never automatic alias access. No unstated flight, extraordinary senses, elemental resistance/immunity, telepathy, spell delivery, Help-based automatic advantage, independent casting, autonomous damage, free healing/resummon, loot, corpse, wages or resource/death triggers. A replacement pays a full new cast. A successful new application owns its own endpoint; stale cleanup of an older application cannot end its replacement. A countered cast creates no replacement. Starting a concentration spell still ends the caster's incompatible prior concentration before interruption. Known/prepared access, actual class rank/level, components, line of effect, RP and other costs, Dissonance/Refrain, class hooks and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Total cover blocks direct targeting and originating line of effect. No automatic upcast or level scaling unless this card explicitly prints companion-profile scaling.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/30 feet/V/S/F/concentration 1 minute and small elemental companion. NEW: explicit standard-derived profile, five elemental choices, fixed melee/ranged mode, ordinary senses/command comprehension, owner command budget and anti-loop limitations. It is distinct from the reviewed spirit Find Familiar and specifically statted Summon Fire Pet.
operational.implementationStatus: REVIEWED authored operational-playtest manuscript; runtime and balance validation pending
